record.dic_text:
03521 Kabuwl {kaw-bool'}

與 03525 同源, 取其"限制"之意; 專有名詞, 地名

AV - Cabul 2; 2

迦步勒 = "結合"
1) 亞設邊界上的城巿 而且位於約在Akko的西方十英哩處 (十六公里);
   現今 'Kabul'
2) 所羅門王給希蘭在加利利內的一個地方, 
   希蘭輕蔑地命名為 '迦步勒'(#王上 9:10-13|)
record.edic_text:
03521 Kabuwl {kaw-bool'}

from the same as 03525 in the sense of limitation;; n pr loc

AV - Cabul 2; 2

Cabul = "binding"
1) a city on the border of Asher and located approx 10 miles (16 km)
   east of Akko; modern 'Kabul'
2) a district in Galilee given by Solomon to Hiram and contemptuously
   called 'Cabul' by Hiram
